column1: This is a commercially healthy Shopify store with a real local brand (Toronto) and a solid technical base. It is NOT losing because Google cannot crawl it. It is losing because collection/page SEO is nearly empty, local SEO is incomplete, the blog is unused, and too many thin/irrelevant collections are publicly indexable. Fixing titles/metas + cleaning collections + adding LocalBusiness/About/FAQ/blog will unlock the biggest gains.
